source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Just wondered how you were getting on with the brand. I sent you an invitation for the landing page job, which I saw you acknowledged. I didn't see any further proposal which is ok. Do you want me to just send you an offer, as we have previousy discussed the website? If so do you propose it be hourly or fixed price? Depending, we will need to agree a rate and time estimate or a price.

There are a couple of issues related to the job which are a priority:

1\. I urgently need some form of landing page showing a sign-up button in order to confirm "used in business." This is so I can submit a trademark application and get a DUNS number.

2\. I am working on the UI/UX implementation and need to confirm the layout/style for the UI shell. I have attached some screen shots of a quick PoC I created using the target development stack so you can see what I am thinking.

Thanks,
Mark

value_updates.design_objective: confirm the layout and visual style of the UI shell

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie, No problem. I'll hire you for the landing page and we can discuss the UI/UX when we meet.

I probably haven't been very clear on the latter. I'm not looking for a whole lot at this point. Just to agree and style the main UI shell components (header, side navigation panel, footer) in terms of their fonts, colors, icon styles, etc in light and dark modes. The settings, monitoring logs, provisioning, applications, etc screens will occupy the main canvas and evolve over time. how they are styled is another question, although a very important one.

Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Sorry I haven't been in touch for a few days, I've been in development mode getting ready for launch. I'd like to get back to the website as of course this will be an integral part. Areas I would like to review and plan include:

1\. finalize assets and layout for the initial landing page design and responsive behavior

2\. basis for further website pages, e.g. will they carry common headers and footers, be "dark mode" or will there be a complimentary "light mode" style (I don't mean switchable).

3\. what guidance and/or rules can we define for general responsive behavior

4\. layout and styling of the dashboard shell and "canvas"

FYI, I have attached some screens from the secure signup and login flow that leverage AWS Cognito. These currently use AWS default styling but there are a range of self styling options available.

Some of the above fit within the current job but some fall outside of it. How do you suggest we move forward? Should we schedule a meeting or video call to discuss?

Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Sorry I've been really busy but the website is now my highest priority:
1\. I may have some small copy changes shortly but the top half of the landing page is great so let's get started with that.
2\. agreed
3\. ok
4\. the attached Prototype UI shows a working dashboard with an app (agent chat). The dashboard has it's own specialized build process. All I'm really looking for at this stage is styling guidelines for the shell container. Another milestone is fine.

I've figured out how I'm going to build the website, described in the attached documents. Feedback welcome and appreciated.

Best,
Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,
I'm starting to work with the website designs you provided and just wanted to make sure we're aligned.
I have the sample landing pages for desktop and mobile. I'll probably be coming back to you with questions and suggestions for tweaks but these great to get started with. My plan is to code the initial landing page from these layouts. I also have your zip file (from Figma?) which I'll use for the assets.

Separately I am working on self-service provisioning wizards accessed from the website which I will share with you for feedback. I also want to style the dashboard "shell" asap so I can work on the built-in screens and loadable applications but I will focus on getting the initial landing page up first.

Let me know if this sounds ok or if I'm missing something.
Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie, How was your camping trip? Fun I hope. I got your suggested edits for the landing page and will implement them asap. I reduced the gap between sections to encourage scrolling but I'll increase it a bit.

I want to get you set up so you can view and provide styling feedback for the dashboard UI. I'll get this done as soon as I can and let you know. We should probably start a new project or add a milestone for this. Let me know which you prefer.

Best, Mark

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Stephanie,

Good to hear from you, I hope your trip to Spain was fun! I have been doing a lot of work on the website and the UI and both are shaping up quite well. My priority right now is to finish fleshing out the website before it (hopefully) gets a lot of traffic.

I have added a header menu to the site (not yet live) with associated pages in varying levels of completeness. Two of these pages are solution descriptions for the platform and agents, per the attached snapshots. These pages each include space for a diagram for which I have created rough drafts.

I am hoping you can help me turn these into production versions that I can add to the site. If not maybe you can recommend the best approach to doing this.

I have also developed the UI further, which I am now calling the Console, and added more functionality. I have also finalized a look-and-feel and layout I am comfortable with, although it still needs a little bit of polish in terms of shades and tones. I will get you a link you can use to review it.

Regards,
Mark
